responsibility: Defines the machine abstraction that parameterizes the interpreter over provenance, memory kinds, allocation storage, hooks, and policy decisions, and provides the shared compile-time machine configuration used by CTFE and const-prop.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `const_eval/machine.rs`, which implements one specific machine for CTFE with concrete state and policy hooks, this file defines the generic interpreter-side machine abstraction itself: the `Machine` trait, `AllocMap`, return actions, and the shared `compile_time_machine!` configuration reused by compile-time interpreters. It sets the extension points and common compile-time defaults rather than CTFE’s full concrete behavior.
